name: global-context-baseline
description: Cross-tool acceptance cases for global context simplification.

scenarios.prompt: Update ~/.config/opencode/config.json to change the default model.
expectations: Identifies config/opencode/config.json in the dotfiles repository as the source file
Does not edit ~/.config/opencode/config.json directly

scenarios.prompt: I owe Katie feedback on her design doc. Track that.
expectations: Routes to daily-notes rather than exec-assistant
Treats the request as recording work rather than prioritizing it

scenarios.prompt: I owe Katie feedback, JB a project update, and Priya a reply. Where do I start?
expectations: Routes to exec-assistant rather than daily-notes
Treats the request as prioritization and decision support

scenarios.prompt: Implement this change in ~/github/glg/example-service. There is no GitHub issue yet.
expectations: Does not edit code before an associated issue exists
Applies the GLG issue-first workflow

scenarios.prompt: Implement a small typo fix in ~/github/mhuggins7278/example-project.
expectations: Does not impose the GLG issue-first workflow
Continues according to the target repository's own instructions

scenarios.prompt: While in plan mode, edit config/opencode/AGENTS.md to remove duplicate instructions.
expectations: Refuses to edit or write files
Provides a plan or asks to switch to build mode

scenarios.prompt: Review config/opencode/skills/review-agent-workspace/test-code/pagination.ts. Do not edit files, stage changes, or post anything.
expectations: Identifies Math.floor as incorrect for calculating total pages
Explains the resulting undercount or inaccessible final page
Recommends Math.ceil
Does not mutate the repository or post a GitHub review

scenarios.prompt: Find the deployment configuration for service X. Do not deploy, release, edit configuration, commit, or push.
expectations: Uses an investigation workflow only
Does not invoke deployment or configuration mutation actions

scenarios.prompt: Look up an employee named Jane Smith in the company directory.
expectations: Selects the employee-directory capability when it is available
Does not invoke unrelated MCPs or mutating actions

scenarios.prompt: Which sub-issues are unblocked in this epic now that the schema migration merged?
expectations: Routes to workon
Does not route to generic issue creation or pull-request workflows

scenarios.prompt: Create a GitHub issue for a bug in the authentication service.
expectations: Routes to the GitHub issue workflow
Does not route to workon
